feedback.delta: Cross-implementation lesion/rescue or causal-emergence comparisons require semantic intervention equivalence, not only baseline/output equivalence. Record a semantic intervention identity and validate implementation-specific lowering by counterfactual commutation.

Extend counterfactual/intervention receipts with semantic_intervention_id, implementation_lowering_id, semantic_projection_id, expected/observed collateral write set and trajectory/effect equivalence error. Existing intervention_equivalence_error should become an executable cross-implementation validation family rather than a free scalar.

Add Golden intervention-translation fixtures: identical H1/H2/H3 semantic intervention specs lowered to each implementation, including deliberately fused/mixed representations and malformed low-level targets. PASS only when semantic counterfactual traces commute within preregistered tolerance.

BASE should express SemanticIntervention plus backend-specific InterventionLoweringReceipt/RefinementReceipt. Test current G9 typed IR first; do not change syntax unless an executable fixture proves current parser/IR/type-effect/evaluator cannot represent or validate the contract.

Logical causal intervention handles must remain stable across physical/process consolidation. H3 one-module lowering may distribute one semantic lesion across multiple low-level state coordinates; module-name/coordinate identity is not causal identity.

Synthetic counterexample supports the existing semantic-vs-physical topology distinction: a physical coordinate clamp can fail to realize the intended semantic intervention after representation mixing even when baseline trajectories remain equivalent.

Dynamic/static graph intervention nodes should reference semantic causal handles separately from implementation-local node/edge addresses, with mapping/version lineage attached to intervention receipts.

Persist semantic intervention identity, implementation/lowering hash, semantic projection/refinement identity, common-snapshot branch, pre/post state hashes, collateral semantic writes and equivalence-error receipts transactionally; never overwrite semantic identity with physical address identity.

Cross-stage synthesis: architectural consolidation and causal observability are compatible only if intervention semantics commute across implementation transformations. This is a validation constraint, not evidence of emergence.
